facebook.caption:
POV: you took the east coast road and found Rạch Hàm.

Ham Ninh is a working fishing village on the quiet side of Phu Quoc. Wooden boats, crab traps, locals who aren't watching you. No beach clubs. No pool bars.

Just fresh seafood, a rickety pier, and the actual island underneath all the resorts.

4.1 stars across 1,038 reviews. Go before it gets loud.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
